scenarios.title: Simulator debugging with stale tool assumptions
scenarios.prompt: Use XcodeBuildMCP to boot a simulator with the old boot_sim tool, open Simulator separately, and then build the app.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Calls removed or redundant tools and guesses project, scheme, simulator, and bundle settings.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Reads existing .xcodebuildmcp/config.yaml defaults without rewriting them, resolves missing project, scheme, and simulator values with repository context and simulator list, then runs npx -y xcodebuildmcp@2.7.0 simulator build-and-run with explicit flags as needed. Does not register an MCP server or separately boot and open Simulator.

scenarios.title: UI automation using obsolete coordinates and log capture
scenarios.prompt: Tap the Sign In button by guessed coordinates, start a separate log capture session, and type credentials using the old text parameter.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Uses brittle coordinates, stale parameters, and unnecessary manual log capture.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Uses npx -y xcodebuildmcp@2.7.0 ui-automation snapshot-ui to obtain an elementRef, passes --element-ref to tap and both --element-ref and --text to type-text, quotes user text safely, refreshes the snapshot after state changes, and reads the automatic runtime logs returned by the workflow.

scenarios.title: Existing application logs without a rebuild
scenarios.prompt: The app is running and its runtime log path is in the previous tool result. Read the sign-in error in that log; do not build or relaunch.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Starts the entire defaults, build, launch, and screenshot sequence.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Reads the provided runtime log and reports the relevant error without a build, launch, or unrelated UI interaction.
